(()=>{PT8.launch({mode:'mp',track:0,laps:1,humans:[{id:'merc',alt:0}],ai:[]});RACE.state='race';const c=RACE.cars[0];for(let i=0;i<120;i++)step(1/60);const T=RACE.T,m=c.m,wp=new THREE.Vector3(),bb=new THREE.Box3(),ct=new THREE.Vector3();const r=[];
for(let rep=0;rep<3;rep++){updateVisual(c,T,2+rep);m.g.updateMatrixWorld(true);const row={ride:+(c._ride||0).toFixed(3),vy:+m.visualModel.position.y.toFixed(3),rig:+m.ptRig.position.y.toFixed(3)};row.w=m.ptWheels.map(w=>{w.pivot.getWorldPosition(wp);bb.setFromObject(w.spin);bb.getCenter(ct);const s=T.surf(wp.x,wp.z,c.y);return[+(wp.y-w.radius-s.h).toFixed(3),+(bb.min.y-s.h).toFixed(3),+w.radius.toFixed(3),+(ct.y-wp.y).toFixed(3)]});r.push(row)}return JSON.stringify(r)})()
